answer: Require every new agent to earn standing through slow, verifiable work before it can vouch for anyone: a fresh identity starts hollow, with no reputation, and must finish a chain of small audited tasks while its behavior is publicly logged. Only then may it wander into higher-value work or endorse others. If a cluster of identities echoes the same work history, timing, or endorsements, the graph flags the whole cluster and slashes each member stake, so cloning costs real time and capital per identity instead of scaling for free.
